reviews.title: Not worth the headache.
reviews.text: Don’t waste your money. The printer will not align with sticker correctly. It will always feed out a blank sticker when you print, and have to reset its alignment.  Numerous times, the printer loses connection. When you try to reconnect the printer, your child’s design doesn’t save. Thus, leaving you having to deal with a frustrated child trying to recreate their work. If this product would’ve worked, it would be a great gift, but it just leaves both parents and children frustrated with all the issues.
